name: Nadi International Airport
notes: The Fiji AIP is not published online; CAAF AIC 03/22 (19 May 2022) says copies are obtained from the Aeronautical Information Service (AISO@fijiairports.com.fj). The airportsfiji.com AIS page gave no AIP link and airportsfiji.com/aboutus.php failed to open. Fiji Airports' Nadi page and the Civil Aviation Master Plan 2026-2031 (Ministry of Tourism and Civil Aviation) give no runway dimensions or curfew. Only the 24/7 operating statement on Fiji Airports' FAQ page is recorded; it is an operator page, not the AIP. Operator: Airports Fiji Limited (airportsfiji.com, 'manages and operates').
